title: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(3)
desc: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(3)

paragraphs.en: There are people on bicycles in Niassa, too, though not so many.
paragraphs.zh: 尼亚萨保护区也有人骑自行车，只不过数量不多。

paragraphs.en: A few small villages of mudbrick and thatch have grown up along the road that bisects the reserve.
paragraphs.zh: 几座由泥砖与茅草搭建而成的小村庄，沿着横穿保护区的道路慢慢发展起来。

paragraphs.en: We saw women, mostly, balancing water canisters or bundles of firewood on their heads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们看见大多是妇女，头顶着水罐或是一捆捆柴火，稳稳地前行。

paragraphs.en: A few men fished from shanties on the sandy riverbanks. Small children waved.
paragraphs.zh: 少数男子在沙质河岸上的简易棚屋里捕鱼。年幼的孩子们朝我们挥手。

paragraphs.en: I waved back, awkwardly regal, high on a bench on the back of the truck.
paragraphs.zh: 我坐在卡车后排高高的座椅上，略显拘谨又带着几分庄重地挥手回应。

paragraphs.en: The residents of Niassa are some of the poorest people in one of the poorest countries in the world; here, 80% live on less than $2 a day.
paragraphs.zh: 尼亚萨当地居民身处全球最贫困国家之一，属于最穷苦的一批人；这里百分之八十的人每日生活费不足两美元。

paragraphs.en: Mozambique gained independence from Portugal in 1975, but was ravaged by a brutal civil war that ran until 1992, during which time more than a million died from violence or starvation.
paragraphs.zh: 莫桑比克于1975年脱离葡萄牙获得独立，却饱受一场残酷内战的摧残，战火一直持续到1992年，期间有超过一百万人死于暴力冲突或是饥荒。

paragraphs.en: The country's wildlife was also devastated, as desperate people turned to bushmeat for survival – animal populations declined by 90% or more in some areas.
paragraphs.zh: 该国的野生动物同样遭到重创，走投无路的人们开始猎食野味以求生存——部分地区动物数量锐减百分之九十甚至更多。

paragraphs.en: The remoteness and sheer inaccessibility of the Niassa wilderness lent it some protection, for humans and animals both.
paragraphs.zh: 尼亚萨荒野地处偏远、人迹罕至，这反倒给当地的人类与动物都提供了一层庇护。

paragraphs.en: Villagers fled into the bush, setting up temporary camps.
paragraphs.zh: 村民们逃进丛林，搭建起临时营地。

paragraphs.en: A few live there still, slashing and burning to create small clearings, growing what they can, then moving on.
paragraphs.zh: 至今仍有一小部分人居住在那里，刀耕火种开辟小块空地，能种什么就种什么，之后便迁往下一处。

paragraphs.en: All this is to say that wilderness preservation was low on the list of priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 这一切都说明，荒野保护在当时绝非优先考虑事项。

paragraphs.en: It is difficult to think about aesthetics, landscape ethics, sustainable harvest, when you fear for your life.
paragraphs.zh: 当你连自身性命都难以保全时，根本无暇顾及景观美感、土地伦理或是可持续捕猎。

paragraphs.en: More recently, under significant pressure from international NGOs, poaching has become a priority issue.
paragraphs.zh: 近些年来，在国际非政府组织施加的巨大压力之下，打击偷猎成为了重点工作。

paragraphs.en: It was criminalised in 2014, and since then several kingpins have been handed sentences of 20 years or more.
paragraphs.zh: 偷猎行为于2014年被定为刑事犯罪，从那以后多名偷猎头目被判处二十年及以上刑期。

paragraphs.en: Anti-poaching rangers patrol known hideouts.
paragraphs.zh: 反偷猎护林员会巡查已知的偷猎藏身点。

paragraphs.en: This, at least in part, is where the money from the lion hunts is going.
paragraphs.zh: 猎狮所得的收入，至少有一部分就被投入到这项工作当中。

paragraphs.en: Lion hunts are perhaps the most important income generator for the Luwire Conservancy, a private environmental organisation that manages hunting block L7, the 4,500 sq km subdivision of the Niassa special reserve I was casing with Stones and his client.
paragraphs.zh: 卢威尔保护区是一家私营环保机构，负责管理L7狩猎区块，也就是我跟随斯通斯和他的客户探访的尼亚萨特别保护区内这片面积4500平方公里的区域，猎狮或许是它最重要的收入来源。

paragraphs.en: The conservancy, which has controlled the block since 2000, works with the local community to minimise impact on the wilderness they live alongside.
paragraphs.zh: 该保护区自2000年起管理这片土地，它与当地社区展开合作，尽可能降低人类活动对周边荒野环境造成的影响。

paragraphs.en: In return for containing development to agreed areas, the conservancy offers clean water in the form of boreholes, medical care in the form of flying doctors, jobs in the form of rangers, a share of bushmeat every year, ready killed, plus meat gifted from the trophy hunters, at their discretion.
paragraphs.zh: 作为回报，当地社区同意将开发活动限定在指定区域内，保护区则为他们提供钻井获取的洁净水源、空中出诊医生带来的医疗服务、护林员岗位、每年定量分配已经宰杀好的野味，另外战利品猎人还可自愿赠予一部分肉食。

paragraphs.en: Later, I would go out with a professional hunter from the conservancy as he "harvested" bushmeat to fill the annual quota.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，我跟着保护区的一名职业猎手外出，他要“捕猎野味”来完成每年的配额。

paragraphs.en: This would be a very different kind of hunt - quick and clinical - and within what felt like minutes the young man – strong-jawed, blond-haired – returned with an impala held aloft by the ankles, still lithe and perfect, save for the finger-sized hole punched through the barrel of its chest.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种截然不同的狩猎——干脆利落、不带多余情绪，仿佛没过几分钟，那位下颌坚毅、金发的年轻猎手就回来了，他提着一只黑斑羚的脚踝将它高高举起，躯体依旧柔韧完好，只有胸口处留下一个手指粗细的弹孔。

paragraphs.en: Great crowds turned out to watch the carcass portioned out.
paragraphs.zh: 大批村民赶来围观猎物被分割。

paragraphs.en: The butchering itself was rough and inexpert, conducted rapidly with a serrated knife on the side of the road.
paragraphs.zh: 分割过程粗糙而并不专业，人们就在路边用一把锯齿刀快速处理。

paragraphs.en: The animal's organs spilled out and were gathered eagerly in a bucket.
paragraphs.zh: 动物的内脏掉落在地上，被众人急切地收集到桶中。

paragraphs.en: Its haunches were hacked off and hauled away by the most fortunate.
paragraphs.zh: 它的后腿被砍了下来，由最幸运的人扛走。

paragraphs.en: The idea is that, in exchange for these gifts, the people will allow the other, rarer and notionally more valuable animals to pass through their village unharmed.
paragraphs.zh: 这项安排背后的设想是，村民收下这些肉食馈赠后，就会允许其他更为珍稀、理论上价值更高的动物平安穿过村庄，不受伤害。

paragraphs.en: But the unbalanced dynamic – the squire throwing his offcuts to the dust for his public to divide – felt, to me, uncomfortable.
paragraphs.zh: 但这种不对等的关系——就像乡绅把残羹剩饭扔到尘土里，任由民众争抢，让我心里很不是滋味。

paragraphs.en: As was the irony of their situation: the residents of a hunting preserve prohibited from hunting for themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 而当地居民所处的境遇更是充满讽刺：狩猎保护区内的本地人，反倒被禁止自行狩猎。
